partners.mechanism_chain: GJB6 (HGNC:4355) —DISRUPTS→ Gap junction assembly (GO:0005941); GJC2 (HGNC:14961) —DISRUPTS→ Gap junction assembly (GO:0005941); Gap junction assembly (GO:0005941) —LEADS_TO→ Hair defects (HP:0001052); Gap junction assembly (GO:0005941) —LEADS_TO→ Spasticity (HP:0001257); Gap junction assembly (GO:0005941) —LEADS_TO→ Leukodystrophy (HP:0003420).
